instruction.name: xvst
instruction.description: Write whole vector data in `data` to memory address `addr + offset`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvst $xr0, $r20, 0; xvst $xr1, $r20, 32; xvst $xr2, $r20, 64; xvst $xr3, $r20, 96; xvst $xr4, $r20, 128; xvst $xr5, $r20, 160; xvst $xr6, $r20, 192; xvst $xr7, $r20, 224
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'xvst $xr0, $r20, 0; xvst $xr1, $r20, 32; xvst $xr2, $r20, 64; xvst $xr3, $r20, 96; xvst $xr4, $r20, 128; xvst $xr5, $r20, 160; xvst $xr6, $r20, 192; xvst $xr7, $r20, 224'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
